cases.expected: Result string starts with "$1$" + expectedSalt + "$" and the hash part is non‑null
cases.description: An empty password must still produce a valid MD5‑crypt hash; the salt is generated from the supplied Random.
Using a fixed Random seed (42) the B64.getRandomSalt(8, random) always returns the same 8‑character salt (eJ5rYjG/). The full hash is therefore deterministic.

group: Different Random Seeds Produce Different Salts

cases.expected: Result string starts with "$1$" + salt2 + "$" where salt2 != salt1
